newsitem.title: FRANCE: Police arrest man with mock bomb in Paris.
newsitem.headline: Police arrest man with mock bomb in Paris.

text.p: Police arrested a disgruntled litigant after he chained himself to law court railings with a mock bomb and threatened to blow himself up.
Police detained the hoaxer, who had been demanding a meeting with the head of the Supreme Court over a legal dispute, after sealing off the area near Notre-Dame cathedral for about an hour.
Bomb disposal experts who examined the suitcase that the man was holding found nothing inside but modelling clay with a few wires sticking out.
